story_type: hoist off a famous ocean liner in the winter Atlantic
hook: He needed a hospital. He was on the Queen Mary 2.
narration: An eighty-two-year-old needed a hospital, and he was on the Queen Mary 2.
The liner was eighty-five nautical miles southeast of Nantucket, in January.
A Coast Guard crew from Air Station Cape Cod flew out to it.
The ship keeps steaming, so the pilot matches its speed above the deck.
outcome: They flew him to Hanscom Air Force Base, where EMS was waiting.

location_card.place: 85 nautical miles southeast of Nantucket, Massachusetts

title: Airlifted off the Queen Mary 2
description:
On Jan. 4, 2023, a Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod helicopter crew medevaced an 82-year-old man from the cruise ship Queen Mary 2 about 85 nautical miles southeast of Nantucket, Massachusetts, and flew him to Hanscom Air Force Base, where EMS was waiting.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Air Station Cape Cod, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/870331/coast-guard-conducts-medevac-85-miles-southeast-nantucket-massachusetts

facts.claim: Air Station Cape Cod crew medevaced an 82-year-old man from the Queen Mary 2, 85 nautical miles southeast of Nantucket, Jan. 4, 2023
facts.source_quote: A Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod crew successfully conduct a medevac of an 82-year-old male aboard the cruise ship Queen Mary II approximately 85 nautical miles southeast of Nantucket, Massachusetts, Wednesday Jan. 4, 2023.

facts.claim: Flown to Hanscom AFB, EMS took him to Mass General
facts.source_quote: The air crew safely brought the man back to Hanscom Air Force Base where EMS was waiting to transport the man to Massachusetts General Hospital.
